title: Easy Chicken Pot Pie
description: Classic creamy chicken-and-vegetable filling under a flaky store-bought crust.

steps.text: Heat oven to 400°F. Stir chicken, vegetables, soup, milk, and pepper together in the pie pan.
Lay crust over filling, crimp edge, cut vents, and bake until bubbling and golden.

cookSteps.text:
HEAT OVEN to 400°F. STIR TOGETHER:
{{q0}} cooked chicken
{{q1}} frozen mixed vegetables
{{q2}} cream of chicken soup
{{q3}} milk
{{q4}} black pepper

TOP with:
{{q5}} refrigerated pie crust

Crimp edge and cut a few steam vents.
BAKE at 400°F until crust is golden and filling bubbles.

title: Tater Tot Casserole
description: Ground beef, creamy vegetables, cheddar, and crisp tater tots—the familiar weeknight casserole.

steps.text: Heat oven to 375°F and brown beef.
Spread beef, soup, vegetables, and cheese in baking dish; top with tots.
Bake until hot and crisp.

cookSteps.text:
HEAT OVEN to 375°F. BROWN:
{{q0}} ground beef

Drain excess fat.

LAYER:
beef
{{q1}} cream of mushroom soup
{{q2}} mixed vegetables
{{q3}} cheddar
TOP WITH:
{{q4}} frozen tater tots
BAKE at 375°F until bubbling and tots are crisp.

title: Beef & Noodles
description: Tender egg noodles in an easy savory beef gravy.

steps.text: Brown beef and boil noodles.
Stir broth, soup, and pepper into beef; simmer.
Fold in drained noodles.

cookSteps.text:
BROWN:
{{q0}} ground beef

Drain if needed.

BOIL until tender:
{{q1}} egg noodles

Drain.

STIR INTO BEEF:
{{q2}} beef broth
{{q3}} cream of mushroom soup
{{q4}} black pepper

Simmer gently.
FOLD noodles into beef mixture and heat through.

title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
description: Old-school creamy tuna, peas, noodles, and a crunchy topping.

steps.text: Heat oven to 375°F and cook noodles.
Mix noodles with tuna, soup, peas, and milk; top with crackers.
Bake until bubbling.

cookSteps.text:
HEAT OVEN to 375°F. BOIL until tender:
{{q0}} egg noodles

Drain.

MIX:
noodles
{{q1}} tuna
{{q2}} cream of mushroom soup
{{q3}} frozen peas
{{q4}} milk
TOP WITH:
{{q5}} crushed crackers
BAKE at 375°F until hot and bubbling.

title: Cheesy Baked Spaghetti
description: Spaghetti, red sauce, and mozzarella baked into an easy family casserole.

steps.text: Heat oven to 375°F and cook spaghetti just tender.
Toss with sauce, put in baking dish, and top with cheeses.
Bake until melted and bubbling.

cookSteps.text:
HEAT OVEN to 375°F. BOIL until just tender:
{{q0}} spaghetti

Drain.

TOSS spaghetti with:
{{q1}} pasta sauce
TOP WITH:
{{q2}} mozzarella
{{q3}} Parmesan
BAKE at 375°F until cheese melts and edges bubble.

storage: Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze portions up to 2 months.

title: Easy Cottage Pie
description: Savory ground beef and vegetables under a blanket of mashed potatoes.

steps.text: Heat oven to 400°F and brown beef.
Stir in vegetables and gravy; spread in baking dish.
Top with mashed potatoes and optional cheddar; bake.

cookSteps.text:
HEAT OVEN to 400°F. BROWN:
{{q0}} ground beef

STIR IN:
{{q1}} mixed vegetables
{{q2}} beef gravy

Spread in baking dish.

SPREAD ON TOP:
{{q3}} mashed potatoes
OPTIONAL:
{{q4}} cheddar
BAKE at 400°F until hot and lightly browned.

title: Easy Beef & Rice Stuffed Peppers
description: Bell peppers filled with seasoned beef, rice, tomato sauce, and cheese.

steps.text: Heat oven to 375°F and brown beef.
Mix beef with rice and sauce; fill pepper halves and top with cheese.
Bake until peppers are tender.

cookSteps.text:
HEAT OVEN to 375°F. BROWN:
{{q1}} ground beef

MIX beef with:
{{q2}} cooked rice
{{q3}} tomato sauce
FILL:
{{q0}} bell peppers
TOP WITH:
{{q4}} cheddar
BAKE at 375°F until peppers are tender and filling is hot.

title: Oven-Baked Pork Chops & Potatoes
description: Simple seasoned pork chops and potatoes baked together for a familiar supper.

steps.text: Heat oven to 425°F. Toss potatoes with half the oil and seasonings and start baking.
Season pork with remaining oil and seasonings; add to pan and bake until cooked through.

cookSteps.text:
HEAT OVEN to 425°F. TOSS:
{{q1}} potatoes
WITH HALF OF:
{{q2}} olive oil
{{q3}} garlic powder
{{q4}} paprika
{{q5}} salt

Spread on pan.
BAKE potatoes first.

COAT AND SEASON:
{{q0}} pork chops
with remaining oil and seasonings. Add to pan.
BAKE until pork reaches 145°F and potatoes are tender.

title: Chicken & Biscuits Casserole
description: Creamy chicken and vegetables baked under golden refrigerated biscuits.

steps.text: Heat oven to 375°F. Mix chicken, vegetables, soup, and milk in baking dish.
Arrange biscuits on top and bake until biscuits are golden and filling bubbles.

cookSteps.text:
HEAT OVEN to 375°F. MIX IN BAKING DISH:
{{q0}} cooked chicken
{{q1}} mixed vegetables
{{q2}} cream of chicken soup
{{q3}} milk

ARRANGE ON TOP:
{{q4}} refrigerated biscuits
BAKE at 375°F until biscuits are deep golden and filling bubbles around edges.
